name: Planet in Sign
note: Parashari astrology only; Jaimini/KP rules are not blended into this dataset. This file covers the planet-in-sign (rashi) layer, which colors HOW a planet's significations are temperamentally expressed, distinct from planet_in_house, which covers WHERE in life (which house/area) those significations play out. The 'dignity' field marks exaltation/own-sign/debilitation per standard classical tables for the seven classical grahas; for Rahu/Ketu, classical texts disagree on a fixed dignity scheme, so each entry's dignity_note (at the planet level, see the source content) explains this rather than asserting one convention. Actual results in a real chart also depend on house placement, aspects, conjunctions, divisional charts, and dasha — this file should be combined with those other layers, not used in isolation.
rahu_ketu_dignity_note: As a shadow planet (chhaya graha), classical texts disagree on a fixed exaltation/debilitation sign for the lunar nodes (common conventions vary between Taurus/Gemini and Scorpio/Sagittarius for Rahu, with Ketu mirroring the opposite sign). This file does not assert one scheme as definitive; instead each entry describes how the node's amplifying, obsessive (Rahu) or detaching, intuitive (Ketu) nature blends with that sign's own temperament.

verification_pass.method: Cross-checked the DIGNITY table (exaltation/own-sign/debilitation for all 7 classical planets, which every entry's 'dignity' field is drawn from) against multiple independent online astrology references, including moolatrikona sign assignments.
verification_pass.unchanged_after_verification: All 7 exaltation/own-sign/debilitation assignments confirmed exactly as used. One source consulted during this pass appeared to mis-state Jupiter's debilitation sign as Aquarius; two independent sources confirmed Capricorn (as used in this file) is correct, so no change was made — flagging this only because it's a genuinely common point of confusion worth double-checking if you see it stated differently elsewhere.

user_review_pass.method: Spot-check sampling across the file following the online-source verification pass above.
user_review_pass.outcome: Approved as-is; no changes requested. All 108 items marked verified: true.

generated_by: Claude (Cowork) - drafted from training knowledge, cross-checked against online sources; still recommend a final pass against your primary reference text

items.title: Sun in Aries
items.summary: Exalted — bold, pioneering confidence at its strongest.
items.effects: The Sun's authority and vitality express with maximum directness here: courageous, self-reliant, and quick to initiate. Leadership comes naturally and impatience with delay is common. This is considered the Sun's single strongest sign, producing dynamic, achievement-oriented self-expression.

items.title: Sun in Taurus
items.summary: Grounds the ego in material security and steady, patient confidence.
items.effects: Self-worth here is tied to stability, comfort, and reliability rather than dramatic display. The native's leadership style is patient and persistent, valuing tangible results over recognition alone. A tendency toward stubbornness about self-image can emerge when challenged.

items.title: Sun in Gemini
items.summary: Gives a curious, communicative, intellectually restless sense of identity.
items.effects: Ego and self-expression are closely tied to ideas, conversation, and versatility, with the native often identifying strongly with being knowledgeable or well-informed. Confidence can fluctuate with mental stimulation, and sustained focus on a single identity or goal takes conscious effort.

items.title: Sun in Cancer
items.summary: A comparatively softer expression, with identity tied closely to home and emotional security.
items.effects: Because the Sun's outward, dry warmth sits somewhat uneasily in the Moon-ruled sign of Cancer, ego here often expresses through nurturing and protecting rather than assertive display. Self-worth is bound up with family role and emotional bonds, and authority is exercised gently, through care rather than command.

items.title: Sun in Leo
items.summary: Own sign — the Sun's most natural and comfortable self-expression.
items.effects: This is the Sun's home sign, giving dignified, warm-hearted confidence and a natural flair for leadership and creative self-expression. The native thrives on legitimate recognition and generally leads with generosity rather than domination. Pride is strong but tends to be earned rather than empty.

items.title: Sun in Virgo
items.summary: Channels ego and authority into precise, humble, service-oriented expression.
items.effects: Self-worth here is tied to competence, usefulness, and getting details right rather than to public display. The native often underplays their own achievements, and leadership is exercised through careful, methodical example. Self-criticism can undercut confidence if not balanced with self-acceptance.

items.title: Sun in Libra
items.summary: Debilitated — ego and self-worth seek external validation through partnership.
items.effects: The Sun's independent self-assertion is at its weakest here, so identity often forms in relation to others rather than as a standalone conviction, and decisiveness about one's own path can be difficult. Diplomacy and fairness are natural strengths, and this placement often does well when paired with a strong cause or partner, or when the native deliberately cultivates independent self-worth.

items.title: Sun in Scorpio
items.summary: Gives an intense, private, deeply willed sense of self.
items.effects: Identity and authority here are guarded rather than openly displayed, with real confidence expressed through quiet, magnetic intensity rather than performance. The native often channels ego into transformation, research, or matters others avoid, and personal power tends to be considerable once self-mastery is achieved.

items.title: Sun in Sagittarius
items.summary: Expresses identity through expansive, philosophical, freedom-loving confidence.
items.effects: The native's sense of self is tied to belief, ethics, and the pursuit of higher truth, and leadership style tends to be optimistic, generous, and teacher-like. There is a strong need for freedom of thought and movement, and self-worth grows through exploration and principled conviction rather than routine.

items.title: Sun in Capricorn
items.summary: Grounds ego in disciplined ambition and long-term achievement.
items.effects: Self-worth is closely tied to responsibility, status earned through effort, and practical accomplishment rather than natural charisma. Leadership is serious, patient, and duty-bound, and the native's confidence tends to strengthen steadily with age and experience rather than appearing early.

items.title: Sun in Aquarius
items.summary: Expresses identity through individuality balanced against group ideals.
items.effects: The native's sense of self is often tied to being different, visionary, or aligned with humanitarian or unconventional causes rather than to personal glory. Leadership style is detached but genuinely progressive, and there can be inner tension between the desire for personal recognition and loyalty to the collective.

items.title: Sun in Pisces
items.summary: Gives a compassionate, imaginative, and somewhat fluid sense of identity.
items.effects: Ego boundaries here are softer than usual, and self-worth is often tied to empathy, creativity, or spiritual connection rather than assertive self-definition. The native's authority is gentle and inspirational rather than commanding, though clear personal boundaries can require conscious cultivation.

items.title: Moon in Aries
items.summary: Debilitated — quick, impulsive, reactive emotional nature.
items.effects: Emotional responses arise fast and fade fast, favoring direct expression of feeling over patient reflection, which can read as impatience or a short temper. The native needs an outlet for immediate emotional action, and learns emotional maturity by pausing before reacting rather than suppressing the underlying courage this placement provides.

items.title: Moon in Taurus
items.summary: Exalted — calm, stable, deeply contented emotional nature.
items.effects: This is considered the Moon's strongest sign, giving a steady, sensuous temperament that finds genuine comfort in routine, physical comforts, and reliable relationships. Emotional security is built through consistency and tangible signs of care, and the native is generally even-tempered unless their sense of stability is directly threatened.

items.title: Moon in Gemini
items.summary: Gives a curious, communicative, changeable emotional temperament.
items.effects: Feelings are processed and expressed verbally, and emotional satisfaction depends heavily on mental engagement and variety. Moods can shift quickly with new information or conversation, and the native often needs to talk through emotions to fully understand them.

items.title: Moon in Cancer
items.summary: Own sign — the Moon's most natural, deeply nurturing emotional expression.
items.effects: This is the Moon's home sign, producing profound emotional sensitivity, strong intuition, and a natural gift for nurturing and protecting others. Home and family are central to emotional wellbeing, and the native's empathy runs deep, sometimes to the point of absorbing others' feelings as their own.

items.title: Moon in Leo
items.summary: Gives a warm, dramatic, generous emotional temperament that thrives on appreciation.
items.effects: Feelings are expressed openly and with flair, and emotional wellbeing depends significantly on being genuinely seen and valued by others. The native's nurturing style is warm and encouraging, though pride can make it hard to admit vulnerability or ask for support.

items.title: Moon in Virgo
items.summary: Gives an analytical, practical, service-oriented emotional temperament.
items.effects: The native tends to process feelings through analysis rather than pure sensation, often expressing care through practical help rather than open sentiment. There can be a tendency to worry or to hold overly high emotional standards for oneself, and emotional peace comes through order, routine, and useful activity.

items.title: Moon in Libra
items.summary: Ties emotional wellbeing closely to harmony, fairness, and partnership.
items.effects: The native seeks emotional balance through pleasant, cooperative relationships and can feel genuinely unsettled by conflict or disharmony. Diplomacy comes naturally, though there can be difficulty identifying or asserting one's own feelings when they might disrupt peace with others.

items.title: Moon in Scorpio
items.summary: Debilitated — intense, deep, sometimes turbulent emotional nature.
items.effects: Feelings here run extremely deep and are often kept private, with strong undercurrents of passion, suspicion, or possessiveness that can surface unexpectedly. This placement grants formidable emotional resilience and intuition once the native learns to manage intensity constructively rather than letting it become secrecy or control.

items.title: Moon in Sagittarius
items.summary: Gives an optimistic, freedom-loving, philosophically minded emotional temperament.
items.effects: Emotional wellbeing depends on a sense of freedom, adventure, and meaning, and the native tends to process difficult feelings by seeking a bigger-picture perspective. Generosity of spirit is natural, though commitment to emotionally demanding situations can feel restrictive if not framed as personally meaningful.

items.title: Moon in Capricorn
items.summary: Gives a reserved, disciplined, achievement-oriented emotional temperament.
items.effects: The native often manages feelings through practical responsibility rather than open expression, and emotional security is tied to achievement, structure, and reliability. There can be difficulty accessing or showing vulnerability, especially early in life, though emotional depth and warmth tend to grow with maturity and earned trust.

items.title: Moon in Aquarius
items.summary: Gives a detached, intellectually oriented, community-minded emotional temperament.
items.effects: Feelings are often processed with some emotional distance, filtered through ideas and principles rather than pure sentiment, and the native values friendship and belonging within groups. Emotional needs can be unconventional, favoring independence and shared ideals over close, intimate dependency.

items.title: Moon in Pisces
items.summary: Gives a highly sensitive, compassionate, imaginative emotional temperament.
items.effects: The native's empathy and intuition run very deep, often to the point of absorbing the emotional atmosphere around them, and emotional life is rich with imagination, art, or spiritual feeling. Clear boundaries and grounding practices help prevent escapism or emotional overwhelm from this profoundly receptive placement.

items.title: Mars in Aries
items.summary: Own sign (moolatrikona) — Mars at its most direct and powerful.
items.effects: This is Mars's strongest sign, giving bold, pioneering, highly competitive energy expressed with total directness. The native acts first and asks questions later, showing natural courage and leadership in action, though patience with slower processes or people can be limited.

items.title: Mars in Taurus
items.summary: Gives determined, persistent energy applied to material goals.
items.effects: Drive here builds slowly but steadily, favoring practical, patient effort over quick bursts of action, and the native tends to be stubborn once a course of action is chosen. Possessiveness or resistance to change can surface when the native's sense of security or resources feels threatened.

items.title: Mars in Gemini
items.summary: Directs energy toward communication, ideas, and versatile action.
items.effects: The native's assertiveness often shows up verbally, through debate, wit, or quick mental engagement, rather than through physical confrontation. Energy can scatter across multiple interests at once, and sustained focus on a single course of action benefits from conscious discipline.

items.title: Mars in Cancer
items.summary: Debilitated — energy is directed inward or through emotional, protective channels.
items.effects: Direct confrontation feels uncomfortable here, so drive and even anger are often expressed indirectly, through moodiness or protective behavior toward family rather than open assertion. This placement's real strength lies in tenacious, quiet protectiveness once the native learns to act from emotional security rather than defensiveness.

items.title: Mars in Leo
items.summary: Gives confident, dramatic, leadership-oriented courage.
items.effects: The native acts boldly and visibly, enjoying competition and recognition for their achievements, with a proud, passionate approach to pursuing goals. Leadership through decisive action comes naturally, though ego can make it hard to back down once a position is taken.

items.title: Mars in Virgo
items.summary: Applies energy with precision, discipline, and a critical eye for detail.
items.effects: Drive here is methodical and service-oriented rather than flashy, and the native works efficiently toward practical improvement in whatever they undertake. Irritability or perfectionism can surface under pressure, especially when standards are not met by self or others.

items.title: Mars in Libra
items.summary: Channels assertiveness through diplomacy, fairness, and partnership.
items.effects: Because Mars's direct assertiveness sits somewhat uneasily in harmony-seeking Libra, the native may hesitate before confrontation, preferring negotiation or waiting for the right moment to act. Energy is often best applied to causes involving justice or balanced partnership, where conviction and diplomacy can work together.

items.title: Mars in Scorpio
items.summary: Own sign — intense, strategic, deeply powerful drive.
items.effects: This is one of Mars's strongest signs, giving formidable willpower, resourcefulness, and the capacity for sustained, focused intensity toward whatever the native is determined to achieve. The native fights hardest for causes they believe in, sometimes with a secretive or all-or-nothing approach that others find difficult to read.

items.title: Mars in Sagittarius
items.summary: Directs energy toward adventure, exploration, and principled action.
items.effects: The native pursues goals with enthusiasm, directness, and a strong sense of conviction, often connected to travel, belief systems, or expanding horizons. Courage here is optimistic and freedom-loving, though commitment to slow, detailed follow-through can be a weaker point.

items.title: Mars in Capricorn
items.summary: Exalted — highly disciplined, strategic, and effective drive.
items.effects: This is considered Mars's strongest placement for practical achievement, combining raw drive with patience, structure, and long-term ambition. The native accomplishes significant, lasting results through sustained, methodical effort rather than impulsive bursts of energy, making this excellent for leadership and executive action.

items.title: Mars in Aquarius
items.summary: Applies energy toward group causes, innovation, and unconventional action.
items.effects: The native's assertiveness often serves collective or reformist goals rather than purely personal ones, and courage shows up in willingness to challenge convention. There can be tension between individual drive and loyalty to group consensus, and action is most effective when tied to a clear, principled cause.

items.title: Mars in Pisces
items.summary: Debilitated — energy is diffused, intuitive, and best expressed through compassion.
items.effects: Direct, forceful action does not come naturally here, and the native's drive is more easily expressed through creative, spiritual, or self-sacrificing channels than through open assertiveness. Clear boundaries and concrete goals help prevent energy from dissipating into vagueness, escapism, or passive avoidance of conflict.

items.title: Mercury in Aries
items.summary: Gives quick, direct, sometimes impulsive thinking and speech.
items.effects: The native's mind moves fast and favors decisive statements over prolonged deliberation, learning most effectively through direct experience and action. Communication is candid and assertive, occasionally at the cost of tact or patience for detail.

items.title: Mercury in Taurus
items.summary: Gives practical, deliberate, and steady thinking.
items.effects: The native's mind favors concrete, tangible knowledge over abstract theory, and opinions, once formed, tend to be held firmly. Communication is measured and reliable rather than quick, and patience allows for thorough, dependable understanding of practical matters.

items.title: Mercury in Gemini
items.summary: Own sign (moolatrikona) — Mercury at its most versatile and communicative.
items.effects: This is Mercury's home sign, giving exceptionally quick, curious, and adaptable intellect well suited to multitasking, networking, and the exchange of information. The native learns rapidly across many subjects, though sustained depth in a single area requires deliberate focus.

items.title: Mercury in Cancer
items.summary: Gives intuitive, emotionally colored thinking and nurturing communication.
items.effects: Thoughts and memory here are closely tied to feeling, and the native often reasons through emotional context rather than pure logic. Communication style is protective and empathetic, particularly regarding family or close relationships, sometimes making objectivity harder to maintain.

items.title: Mercury in Leo
items.summary: Gives confident, expressive, and creatively engaging communication.
items.effects: The native shares ideas with flair and conviction, enjoying an audience and often expressing intellect through storytelling, teaching, or creative work. Strong self-belief in one's own opinions can make it harder to accept differing viewpoints gracefully.

items.title: Mercury in Virgo
items.summary: Exalted & own sign — Mercury at its most precise and analytically capable.
items.effects: This is considered Mercury's strongest placement, giving exceptional attention to detail, methodical reasoning, and a natural gift for analysis, editing, or organization. The native's thinking is highly practical and thorough, though a tendency toward over-criticism or excessive worry about small errors needs conscious balance.

items.title: Mercury in Libra
items.summary: Gives diplomatic, balanced thinking oriented toward fairness.
items.effects: The native naturally sees multiple sides of an issue and communicates with tact, often seeking consensus or aesthetic harmony in how ideas are expressed. Weighing options carefully can sometimes tip into indecisiveness when a clear, timely choice is needed.

items.title: Mercury in Scorpio
items.summary: Gives penetrating, investigative, strategically minded thinking.
items.effects: The native's mind is drawn to uncovering hidden truths, psychology, or complex systems, and communication can be guarded or strategic rather than openly revealing. Once genuinely interested in a subject, focus and depth of understanding are considerable.

items.title: Mercury in Sagittarius
items.summary: Gives big-picture, philosophical, enthusiastically direct thinking.
items.effects: The native's intellect gravitates toward broad truths, ethics, and higher meaning rather than fine detail, and communication is candid, often blunt, but generally well-intentioned. Enthusiasm for ideas can outpace patience for the finer points of implementation.

items.title: Mercury in Capricorn
items.summary: Gives practical, disciplined, long-term-oriented thinking.
items.effects: The native's mind favors structure, planning, and realistic assessment over abstract speculation, and communication is measured, serious, and purposeful. This placement suits organizational, strategic, or administrative thinking that benefits from patience and methodical follow-through.

items.title: Mercury in Aquarius
items.summary: Gives innovative, independent, systems-oriented thinking.
items.effects: The native's intellect is drawn to original ideas, technology, and group ideals, often approaching problems from an unconventional or theoretical angle. Communication values authenticity and principle over convention, sometimes appearing detached from immediate emotional context.

items.title: Mercury in Pisces
items.summary: Debilitated — imaginative, intuitive, sometimes scattered thinking.
items.effects: The native absorbs and processes information impressionistically, through feeling and imagination rather than strict logical sequence, which can make precise communication or decision-making more challenging. This placement's real strength lies in creative, symbolic, or intuitive understanding once grounding practices support clearer expression.

items.title: Jupiter in Aries
items.summary: Gives enthusiastic, pioneering, expansive optimism.
items.effects: The native approaches new ventures with confidence and generosity, believing strongly in their own capacity to succeed through direct action. Wisdom here is gained through bold experience rather than careful study, and impulsive over-optimism is the main pitfall to watch for.

items.title: Jupiter in Taurus
items.summary: Grounds expansive wisdom in practical, material security.
items.effects: The native's generosity and growth are tied to steady accumulation of resources, comfort, and reliable long-term value rather than risk-taking. Wisdom here is patient and grounded, valuing tangible abundance and ethical, unhurried prosperity.

items.title: Jupiter in Gemini
items.summary: Expands wisdom through communication, learning, and versatile curiosity.
items.effects: The native tends to grow through gathering and sharing knowledge across many subjects, often functioning well as a teacher, communicator, or broad generalist. Depth of philosophical conviction can be diluted by the sheer breadth of interests unless the native chooses to specialize.

items.title: Jupiter in Cancer
items.summary: Exalted — deeply nurturing, generous, and protective wisdom.
items.effects: This is considered one of Jupiter's most auspicious sign placements, expressing expansive generosity through care for family, home, and emotional wellbeing. The native's ethical instincts are strongly protective, and growth in life often comes through nurturing others as much as through personal ambition.

items.title: Jupiter in Leo
items.summary: Gives confident, warm-hearted, dramatically generous wisdom.
items.effects: The native's philosophy of life is expressed with warmth and magnanimity, often taking on a natural teaching or mentoring role that others find inspiring. Growth and good fortune tend to follow generous, big-hearted leadership rather than cautious restraint.

items.title: Jupiter in Virgo
items.summary: Applies expansive wisdom through careful, service-oriented, practical means.
items.effects: Because Jupiter's natural breadth sits somewhat uneasily in detail-oriented Virgo, growth here tends to come through methodical, disciplined effort rather than natural, easy abundance. The native's generosity is expressed through genuinely useful help and precise, well-considered advice rather than grand gestures.

items.title: Jupiter in Libra
items.summary: Expresses wisdom through fairness, diplomacy, and beneficial partnerships.
items.effects: The native's ethical instincts strongly favor justice and balance, often finding good fortune through law, advisory roles, or harmonious relationships. Growth comes through cooperative rather than solitary effort, and a genuinely generous, fair-minded reputation tends to open doors.

items.title: Jupiter in Scorpio
items.summary: Gives deep, intense wisdom about transformation and life's hidden dimensions.
items.effects: The native's philosophical growth often comes through facing crisis, loss, or intensity directly rather than avoiding it, developing considerable resilience and psychological insight as a result. Generosity here can be understated but is genuinely profound, especially in times of others' difficulty.

items.title: Jupiter in Sagittarius
items.summary: Own sign (moolatrikona) — Jupiter at its most naturally wise and expansive.
items.effects: This is Jupiter's home sign, producing natural optimism, strong ethical conviction, and a genuine love of higher learning, travel, and philosophical exploration. The native tends to be a natural teacher or guide, and good fortune follows a life lived according to sincere, generously held principles.

items.title: Jupiter in Capricorn
items.summary: Debilitated — wisdom and growth come slowly, through discipline rather than natural ease.
items.effects: The native's optimism is tempered by caution or a tendency toward self-doubt about their own luck or generosity, requiring patient, structured effort to achieve the growth that comes more easily to other placements. Once earned through sustained discipline, the wisdom and stability gained here tend to be exceptionally solid and lasting.

items.title: Jupiter in Aquarius
items.summary: Expands wisdom through humanitarian ideals and vision for collective progress.
items.effects: The native's generosity and ethical instincts extend readily to causes, communities, and long-term social vision rather than purely personal or family concerns. Growth is often unconventional, favoring innovative or reformist approaches to bettering the wider world.

items.title: Jupiter in Pisces
items.summary: Own sign — deeply spiritual, compassionate, and idealistic wisdom.
items.effects: This is one of Jupiter's most naturally comfortable placements, expressing profound compassion, faith, and intuitive understanding of universal or spiritual truths. The native's generosity is boundless and genuinely selfless, though practical discernment helps ensure idealism translates into real, grounded benefit.

items.title: Venus in Aries
items.summary: Gives passionate, direct, spontaneous approach to love and enjoyment.
items.effects: The native is drawn to the thrill of pursuit and enjoys bold, straightforward romantic expression rather than subtlety or prolonged courtship. Relationships benefit from the native's genuine enthusiasm, though patience with a partner's slower pace can require conscious effort.

items.title: Venus in Taurus
items.summary: Own sign (moolatrikona) — Venus at its most sensuous, loyal, and stable.
items.effects: This is Venus's home sign, giving deep appreciation for beauty, comfort, and physical pleasure alongside genuine loyalty and steadiness in relationships. The native values security and consistency in love, and once committed, tends to remain devoted and dependable.

items.title: Venus in Gemini
items.summary: Gives a playful, communicative, mentally stimulating approach to love.
items.effects: The native is drawn to wit, conversation, and variety in relationships, needing genuine mental connection to sustain romantic interest over time. Charm comes easily, though a need for novelty can create restlessness if a relationship becomes too routine.

items.title: Venus in Cancer
items.summary: Gives a nurturing, emotionally deep approach to love and comfort.
items.effects: The native seeks emotional security and genuine tenderness in relationships, often expressing affection through care, protection, and creating a comfortable home. Sentimentality runs deep, and the native tends to hold onto meaningful relationships and memories closely.

items.title: Venus in Leo
items.summary: Gives a warm, generous, dramatically affectionate approach to love.
items.effects: The native enjoys grand romantic gestures and appreciates being genuinely admired, expressing love with warmth, loyalty, and passion once truly committed. Relationships benefit from mutual recognition and generosity, though a need for admiration can occasionally overshadow a partner's needs.

items.title: Venus in Virgo
items.summary: Debilitated — a practical, sometimes reserved approach to love and affection.
items.effects: The native may find open emotional expression harder here, often showing love through practical acts of service rather than overt sentiment, and can be unduly self-critical about their own worthiness in relationships. Learning to relax perfectionistic standards, in both self and partner, allows this placement's genuine devotion to come through more freely.

items.title: Venus in Libra
items.summary: Own sign — Venus at its most naturally charming, fair, and relationship-oriented.
items.effects: This is Venus's home sign, giving natural grace, diplomacy, and a deep commitment to harmony and fairness in relationships. The native has a refined aesthetic sense and excels at creating balanced, pleasant partnerships, generally making this one of the most favorable placements for love and cooperation.

items.title: Venus in Scorpio
items.summary: Gives an intense, passionate, deeply transformative approach to love.
items.effects: The native seeks profound emotional and physical bonding rather than superficial connection, and relationships here tend to be all-or-nothing in intensity. Possessiveness or secrecy can surface, but genuine loyalty and depth of feeling run remarkably strong once trust is established.

items.title: Venus in Sagittarius
items.summary: Gives a freedom-loving, adventurous, philosophically minded approach to love.
items.effects: The native is drawn to relationships that allow independence, shared exploration, or cross-cultural connection, and enjoys love as an extension of life's broader adventure. Commitment can feel restrictive unless the relationship itself is framed as expansive and growth-oriented.

items.title: Venus in Capricorn
items.summary: Gives a practical, committed, sometimes reserved approach to love.
items.effects: The native values stability, loyalty, and long-term partnership, expressing affection through responsibility and consistent action rather than overt displays of emotion. Relationships tend to deepen and improve with time, as trust is earned through demonstrated reliability.

items.title: Venus in Aquarius
items.summary: Gives a friendship-based, unconventional approach to love and connection.
items.effects: The native values intellectual and ideological compatibility as much as romantic feeling, often building relationships on shared ideals or genuine friendship first. Independence within the relationship is important, and conventional romantic expectations may feel less appealing than an unconventional, equal partnership.

items.title: Venus in Pisces
items.summary: Exalted — deeply compassionate, romantic, and idealistic approach to love.
items.effects: This is considered Venus's strongest placement, giving profound empathy, artistic sensibility, and a self-sacrificing devotion in relationships. The native's capacity for unconditional love and creative or spiritual romantic expression is considerable, though discernment helps prevent idealization of unsuitable partners.

items.title: Saturn in Aries
items.summary: Debilitated — discipline sits uneasily against Aries's impulsive nature.
items.effects: The native often feels frustrated by delays or restrictions on independent action, learning patience and structure through repeated, sometimes hard-won experience. Genuine achievement here comes from gradually tempering impulsiveness with realistic planning rather than suppressing initiative altogether.

items.title: Saturn in Taurus
items.summary: Gives a practical, patient, materially disciplined temperament.
items.effects: The native values steady, long-term security and builds material stability through persistent, unglamorous effort rather than quick gains. There can be resistance to change once a stable routine or possession is established, but reliability and follow-through are genuine strengths.

items.title: Saturn in Gemini
items.summary: Gives a disciplined, structured approach to communication and learning.
items.effects: The native may feel initially restricted in self-expression, but develops serious, methodical intellectual capacity over time through patient study and careful, well-organized communication. Ideas here are fewer but more thoroughly considered than in more naturally scattered placements.

items.title: Saturn in Cancer
items.summary: Brings emotional reserve to a naturally sensitive sign.
items.effects: The native may find it difficult to express vulnerability openly, often taking a disciplined, responsible approach to family duty rather than open emotional display. Genuine emotional maturity and a capacity for structured, protective caretaking tend to develop through the hardships this placement can bring.

items.title: Saturn in Leo
items.summary: Restrains natural self-expression, requiring patient effort to build genuine confidence.
items.effects: The native may struggle with self-doubt or feel unseen early in life, since Saturn's caution sits uneasily with Leo's need for open recognition. Authority and respect, once achieved here, tend to be earned through humble, sustained effort rather than natural charisma, making later-life confidence particularly solid.

items.title: Saturn in Virgo
items.summary: Gives a highly disciplined, methodical, detail-oriented temperament.
items.effects: The native excels at structured, analytical work and takes a patient, thorough approach to responsibilities and problem-solving. Perfectionism or excessive self-criticism can become a burden if not balanced with reasonable expectations and self-compassion.

items.title: Saturn in Libra
items.summary: Exalted — disciplined fairness and structured commitment to relationships.
items.effects: This is considered Saturn's strongest placement, combining a strong sense of justice with the patience and responsibility to build long-term, well-balanced partnerships. The native excels in roles requiring impartial judgment, such as law or diplomacy, and takes relationship commitments seriously and reliably.

items.title: Saturn in Scorpio
items.summary: Gives a disciplined, intense approach to transformation and hidden matters.
items.effects: The native shows considerable patience and endurance when facing crisis or deep psychological material, often developing significant resilience through direct confrontation with fear or loss. A structured, investigative mindset suits research, strategy, or any field requiring sustained focus on complex, sensitive matters.

items.title: Saturn in Sagittarius
items.summary: Gives a disciplined, structured approach to belief systems and higher learning.
items.effects: The native's natural optimism is tempered by caution, and genuine philosophical conviction develops slowly through patient study and lived experience rather than quick faith. Over time, this produces a serious, well-grounded, and durable personal philosophy rather than a superficial one.

items.title: Saturn in Capricorn
items.summary: Own sign (moolatrikona) — Saturn at its most naturally disciplined and effective.
items.effects: This is Saturn's home sign, giving exceptional patience, responsibility, and capacity for long-term achievement, particularly in career and administrative matters. The native's authority is earned through sustained, methodical effort and tends to be genuinely respected rather than merely feared.

items.title: Saturn in Aquarius
items.summary: Own sign — disciplined structure applied to humanitarian and unconventional goals.
items.effects: The native brings genuine responsibility and staying power to group causes, systemic reform, or unconventional long-term projects, valuing principle and structure over personal glory. Detachment can sometimes read as coldness, but the native's commitment to collective progress tends to be sincere and enduring.

items.title: Saturn in Pisces
items.summary: Gives a disciplined approach to compassion, spirituality, and sacrifice.
items.effects: The native may feel emotionally restricted or prone to melancholy, but develops genuine spiritual maturity through patient, humble service to others over time. Structure and realistic boundaries help channel this placement's natural compassion into sustainable, effective support rather than self-depleting sacrifice.

items.title: Rahu in Aries
items.summary: Amplifies bold, pioneering ambition, sometimes to the point of recklessness.
items.effects: The native feels an intense, sometimes obsessive drive to be first, best, or most independent, taking unconventional or bold approaches to self-assertion. This placement rewards channeling that drive into genuine achievement rather than impulsive risk for its own sake.

items.title: Rahu in Taurus
items.summary: Intensifies material ambition and desire for wealth, comfort, and sensory security.
items.effects: The native feels a strong, sometimes insatiable pull toward accumulating resources, luxury, or physical pleasure, which can become a defining life focus. Many practitioners consider this a materially favorable placement for Rahu, provided the native manages a tendency toward excess or overattachment to possessions.

items.title: Rahu in Gemini
items.summary: Amplifies communicative ambition and hunger for information and networking.
items.effects: The native shows an intense, restless curiosity and a strong drive to master communication, media, or unconventional ideas, often functioning as an innovator in how information is shared. Many texts consider this a favorable placement for Rahu's expression, particularly when the native's networking instincts are put to constructive use.

items.title: Rahu in Cancer
items.summary: Amplifies emotional intensity and unconventional patterns around home and security.
items.effects: The native may feel a strong, sometimes obsessive pull regarding domestic status, emotional security, or the mother's role, occasionally creating restlessness about one's own roots or nurturing style. Working consciously with this placement can turn an unsettled inner sense of home into a genuinely expanded, unconventional form of emotional belonging.

items.title: Rahu in Leo
items.summary: Amplifies the desire for recognition, status, and dramatic self-expression.
items.effects: The native feels an intense, sometimes obsessive need for validation and visibility, approaching leadership or creative self-expression in bold, unconventional ways. Real fulfillment here comes from channeling this hunger for recognition into genuinely earned achievement rather than status-seeking alone.

items.title: Rahu in Virgo
items.summary: Amplifies analytical ambition and unconventional approaches to work and service.
items.effects: The native may develop an intense, sometimes anxious perfectionism, driven to innovate within practical, technical, or health-related fields. This placement rewards disciplined channeling of Rahu's restless energy into genuinely useful expertise rather than obsessive worry over details.

items.title: Rahu in Libra
items.summary: Amplifies desire for status and validation through relationships and partnership.
items.effects: The native may idealize partnership or approach fairness and diplomacy in unconventional, intense ways, sometimes creating instability in close relationships through excessive expectation. Genuine growth here comes from grounding the drive for partnership in realistic, mutual understanding rather than idealized fantasy.

items.title: Rahu in Scorpio
items.summary: Intensifies fascination with hidden, taboo, or transformative matters.
items.effects: The native often feels a magnetic, sometimes destabilizing pull toward power, secrecy, or the occult, and many classical conventions consider this a more difficult placement for Rahu requiring conscious self-awareness. When channeled constructively, this placement can produce genuinely penetrating insight into psychology, research, or transformative work.

items.title: Rahu in Sagittarius
items.summary: Amplifies unconventional belief systems and hunger for foreign or nontraditional wisdom.
items.effects: The native often feels a restless pull to question inherited tradition, seeking unconventional philosophies, foreign teachings, or unusual paths to higher truth. This placement rewards embracing an authentic, self-derived belief system rather than either blindly following convention or restlessly rejecting all structure.

items.title: Rahu in Capricorn
items.summary: Amplifies ambition for status, authority, and material achievement.
items.effects: The native feels an intense drive to rise within social or professional hierarchies, sometimes taking unconventional or unorthodox routes to establish authority and structure. Real success here comes from pairing this ambition with genuine discipline rather than shortcuts that undermine long-term stability.

items.title: Rahu in Aquarius
items.summary: Amplifies futuristic, unconventional ambition tied to technology and group causes.
items.effects: The native often feels strongly drawn to innovation, reform, or unconventional social causes, sometimes to the point of detachment from more traditional personal ties. This placement favors visionary, forward-thinking work, particularly when the native's individuality is channeled toward genuinely constructive collective progress.

items.title: Rahu in Pisces
items.summary: Amplifies spiritual or escapist longing and unconventional imagination.
items.effects: The native may feel an intense, sometimes confusing pull toward the unseen, foreign spiritual paths, or idealized fantasy, occasionally blurring the line between genuine intuition and escapism. Grounding this placement's imaginative hunger in concrete, compassionate action helps transform confusion into genuine spiritual or creative insight.

items.title: Ketu in Aries
items.summary: Reduces attachment to assertive self-interest and personal ambition.
items.effects: The native may feel a subtle disconnect from ordinary competitive drive, acting with quiet, intuitive confidence rather than aggressive self-assertion. This placement often reflects past-life mastery of independent courage, now expressed as understated rather than showy strength.

items.title: Ketu in Taurus
items.summary: Reduces attachment to material comfort, security, and sensory pleasure.
items.effects: The native often shows genuine indifference toward accumulating wealth or possessions, finding material attachment less compelling than most people do. This placement supports a naturally simple, spiritually oriented relationship with resources and physical comfort.

items.title: Ketu in Gemini
items.summary: Reduces attachment to conventional communication and intellectual curiosity.
items.effects: The native may feel scattered or restless with ordinary information-gathering, sometimes preferring intuitive knowing over analytical study. Speech tends to be selective and minimal rather than expansive, occasionally masking a deep, quietly held understanding.

items.title: Ketu in Cancer
items.summary: Reduces attachment to conventional home life and emotional dependency on family.
items.effects: The native may feel a degree of emotional distance from domestic roots or the nurturing role expected by family, seeking security through inner rather than external means. This placement often reflects a need to find belonging that is not dependent on conventional home or family structures.

items.title: Ketu in Leo
items.summary: Reduces attachment to recognition and dramatic self-expression.
items.effects: The native often feels genuinely indifferent to public validation or being the center of attention, exercising quiet rather than showy authority. This placement can reflect past-life mastery of leadership, now expressed through understated, humble influence.

items.title: Ketu in Virgo
items.summary: Reduces attachment to perfectionistic analysis and rigid daily routine.
items.effects: The native may feel scattered regarding health habits or meticulous work, preferring intuitive shortcuts over methodical, step-by-step process. This placement can reflect past-life mastery of service or skill, now expressed as effortless, sometimes unexplainable competence.

items.title: Ketu in Libra
items.summary: Reduces attachment to conventional partnership and social harmony-seeking.
items.effects: The native may feel a degree of ambivalence or detachment in close relationships, sometimes finding balance through inner reflection rather than through relational compromise. This placement can indicate a need to develop fairness and equilibrium independently, rather than relying solely on partnership for a sense of completeness.

items.dignity: see dignity_note (classical texts disagree for the lunar nodes)
items.title: Ketu in Scorpio
items.summary: Considered one of Ketu's most naturally comfortable placements — deep intuitive mastery of transformation.
items.effects: The native often shows genuine detachment from material power struggles or possessiveness, paired with profound, sometimes uncanny insight into psychology, the occult, or life's hidden dimensions. This placement frequently reflects significant past-life spiritual work around intensity and transformation, now expressed as natural depth rather than turmoil.

items.title: Ketu in Sagittarius
items.summary: Reduces attachment to conventional, doctrinal belief systems.
items.effects: The native may feel restless with organized religion or fixed philosophy, trusting an innate, largely unspoken sense of truth over external doctrine. This placement can reflect past-life mastery of wisdom, now expressed as quiet, intuitive understanding rather than active teaching or preaching.

items.title: Ketu in Capricorn
items.summary: Reduces attachment to conventional ambition, status, and career achievement.
items.effects: The native may feel genuinely indifferent to climbing social or professional hierarchies, exercising authority and responsibility effortlessly rather than through visible striving. This placement can reflect past-life mastery of discipline, now expressed as natural, unforced capability.

items.title: Ketu in Aquarius
items.summary: Reduces attachment to group identity and collective social causes.
items.effects: The native may feel detached from group belonging even while intellectually sympathetic to humanitarian or reformist ideals, preferring an independent, sometimes solitary path even among the unconventional. This placement favors an intuitive, personally derived sense of vision rather than adherence to any collective ideology.

items.title: Ketu in Pisces
items.summary: Considered one of Ketu's most naturally resonant placements — deep spiritual intuition and compassion.
items.effects: This mirrors Ketu's comfortable dignity in the 12th house of liberation, giving profound imagination, empathy, and a strong pull toward dissolving the ego in service of something greater. The native often shows a natural, largely effortless spiritual sensitivity, with worldly ambition holding relatively little pull compared to inner or transcendent concerns.
